notes: A.1 item 149 — the consistency rules for feature-name-1 when the clause is used with an external file connector, conditionally required on feature-name-1 existing. Since kb/Work PB5844 it exists (item 150: BINARY-SEQUENTIAL, LINE-SEQUENTIAL), so the rule is specified in docs/CONFORMANCE.md §7: the entries are consistent when their clauses select the same method — BINARY-SEQUENTIAL, an omitted clause and the declined STANDARD-1 all leave the record sequential length prefix, and LINE-SEQUENTIAL is the line sequential file's method. FileEntryIdentity.Segments compares the method (its DELIM segment), at compile time through COBOL6847 and at run time through EC-EXTERNAL-FILE-MISMATCH; ExternalFileEntryIdentityTests pins both the agreement and the difference. retired-witness: conformance-test:DocumentedNonSupportWitnessTests.RecordDelimiterFeatureName_NamedNonSupportWarning_PinnedToSpec (kb/Work PB5844 provides feature-name-1, so the condition is present and the test that pinned its absence is deleted)
